title: Nazeeh Johnson says his PED suspension is for taking a fertility medication

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nazeeh Johnson says his PED suspension is for taking a fertility medication
sources.description: Titans cornerback Nazeeh Johnson, who has been suspended for the first six games of the season for violating the NFL policy on performance-enhancing substances, says his violation came from his and his wife's efforts to conceive a child.
